description: This file defines the 'SoundRecorder' class, which manages audio recording from the device microphone to internal storage and playback of the recorded audio. It provides methods for starting/stopping recording and playback, and handles audio system setup and resource management.

classes.name: SoundRecorder
classes.description: A helper class to record audio input from the microphone and playback the recorded audio, with lifecycle management and internal state control.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Initiates audio recording from the device microphone in a background task.

methods.name: startPlay
methods.description: Begins playback of the recorded audio file in a background task.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Releases resources related to audio playback and recording.
